name: Miro
tagline: Read your boards, and draw diagrams, notes and frames on them.
summary: Read and work on the user's Miro boards: find boards and what is on them, and add diagrams, sticky notes, images and comments. Existing items are changed or removed, and boards shared, only after the user approves.
can: Find your boards and read what is on them
Make new boards, and add diagrams, notes, images and comments
Change or remove what is already on a board, or share one, only after you approve it
